tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: Storyville Red, rgb(167, 47, 47). Headlines, accent rules, CTAs, callout borders, table header rows. Accent, never dominant fill. As text: on color-bg-light (6.4:1) and color-surface-alt (5.8:1) only. Never as text on color-bg-dark (2.5:1, fails).

tokens.name: color-bg-light
tokens.usage: Off-White (Natural Warm), rgb(250, 248, 245). Primary page/screen surface for all digital, proposals and print. Replaces pure #FFFFFF everywhere.

tokens.name: color-bg-dark
tokens.usage: Soft Charcoal, rgb(33, 29, 27). Dark surface for reversed sections, dark table headers and dark panels.

tokens.name: color-text-primary
tokens.usage: Soft Charcoal. All body text on color-bg-light (15.8:1) and color-surface-alt (14.3:1). Replaces pure #000000.

tokens.name: color-text-reversed
tokens.usage: Near-White. Headlines, short labels and table header text on color-bg-dark (15.8:1) and color-accent (6.4:1). Body copy on color-accent.

tokens.name: color-text-body-dark
tokens.usage: Muted Off-White, rgb(212, 206, 204). Body paragraphs on color-bg-dark (10.7:1), where full color-text-reversed causes halation at reading size.

tokens.name: color-surface-alt
tokens.usage: Surface Gray, rgb(240, 237, 232). Alternating table rows and callout box fills, on color-bg-light pages.

tokens.name: color-border
tokens.usage: Border Gray, rgb(200, 196, 192). Table borders, dividers and subtle rules. Decorative only (1.6:1 on color-bg-light): never the only boundary of a control.

styles.name: svr-display-h1
styles.sample: We Tell Stories That Move People
styles.usage: Display / H1: headings, section titles, hero type. Spec 36–48pt (48–64px); 64px is the top of the range, step down to 48px on narrow screens.

styles.name: svr-subheading-h2
styles.usage: Subheading / H2: sub-sections and card headers. Spec 24–30pt (32–40px).

styles.name: svr-eyebrow
styles.usage: Eyebrow label above headlines. Always uppercase and tracked. Spec 9–10pt bold.

styles.name: svr-body
styles.sample: From concept to final cut, Storyville RD crafts video content with intention.
styles.usage: All running body copy. Spec 10–11pt; 11pt (≈15px) on screen.

styles.name: svr-caption
styles.sample: Behind the scenes, Las Vegas shoot.
styles.usage: Image captions, fine print, footnotes. Spec 8–9pt.

styles.name: svr-table-header
styles.usage: Table header cells, reversed on color-accent or color-bg-dark. Spec 10pt bold.

styles.name: svr-table-body
styles.usage: Table body cells on alternating color-bg-light / color-surface-alt rows. Spec 10pt.

spacing.note: Not defined in the brand guidelines; a 4px-based scale added so components share one rhythm.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between eyebrow and headline; icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Table cell vertical padding; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding; button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Paragraph spacing; callout padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Padding of full-width Surface bands.

radius.note: Not defined in the brand guidelines; kept nearly square to match the rectangular mark and accent rules.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Tables, Surface bands, accent rules.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and callouts.

tokens.name: rule-accent
tokens.usage: Storyville Red accent rule under section headers and atop cards.

tokens.name: rule-hairline
tokens.usage: color-border dividers and table borders; callout borders in color-accent.
